Overall water quality outcome by bay segment and year

Source: R/anlz_wq_overall.R
anlz_wq_overall.Rd

Overall water quality outcome by bay segment and year

Usage

anlz_wq_overall(
  wqindicators,
  bay_segments = c("OTB", "HB", "MTB", "LTB"),
  yr_min = 2000
)

Arguments

wqindicators

output of anlz_wq_indicators

bay_segments

chr vector of bay segments to include, defaults to c('OTB', 'HB', 'MTB', 'LTB'), the four segments with the most complete indicator coverage

yr_min

integer, minimum year to include, defaults to 2000

Value

A data.frame with columns bay_segment, yr, outcome (0-1, 1 = best), and n_indicator (number of indicators averaged for that segment/year)

Details

Averages outcome across whatever indicators have data for a given bay segment/year - see n_indicator in the output for how many contributed. This is a water-quality-only score: how sediment, fish/wildlife, and habitat indicators combine with it into one overall bay-segment score is not yet designed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
anlz_wq_overall(wqindic)
} # }
